scenarios.name: Normal
scenarios.blurb: The base world: steady buyers, two rainy sowing days, one caterpillar attack.

scenarios.name: Wet season
scenarios.blurb: Rain stops six more sowings and pests take 15-30% of a bed five more times (Nov-Feb).

scenarios.name: Demand grows
scenarios.blurb: Restaurant B grows +4% a week for ten weeks (+40%), then stays there.

scenarios.name: Volatile orders
scenarios.blurb: Orders swing twice as much, and about one in twelve is a 2.5x party order.
